Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers

Class EventController

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers.EventController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/events") public class EventController extends Object
REST controller for managing gaming events. Provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting events, as well as searching events by various criteria.
